newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Swissair may write off Sabena investment in spring.
newsitem.headline: Swissair may write off Sabena investment in spring.

text.p: Swissair may write off its investment in loss-making Belgian airline Sabena this coming spring, but this is no prelude to a total pull-out by the Swiss carrier, Sabena's chief executive said on Tuesday.
"It might be that Swissair is going to write off its investment this spring. The formal decision is not yet taken," Paul Reutlinger told a meeting of the European Aviation Club.
"I want to make clear...this does not mean that Swissair is going out of this investment," he said.

Swissair paid six billion Belgian francs for a 49.5 percent stake in Sabena in 1995.

"It is a pure accounting measure. With the consolidation of (its) accounts, Swissair has to take 49.5 percent of the Sabena loss into account in their balance sheet which is naturally detrimental to (its) result," he said.
Reutlinger said last October that Swissair was effectively threatening to abandon its stake in partly state-owned Sabena unless it started making profits soon.
Swissair is seeking a return on capital employed of four percent in 1998 and eight percent in 2000.
